d:
We present a number of excerpts from the Madhyalaya and Drut Gats of Raga Gurjari Todi (also known as Gujri Todi) presented by the Santoor Legend Pandit Shivkumar Sharma at a Sama Arts morning concert at the Institute of Contemporary Arts (ICA) in London in July 1993.
Accompanying Shivji on the Tabla was Pandit Anindo Chatterjee. This concert was the finalé of an extensive UK tour of the two maestros with Sama Arts and Navras Records.
